title: TopKRouter expert_bias gets wrong dtype (bf16 instead of fp32)
root_cause: Float16Module converts all registered buffers to bf16/fp16. expert_bias is a fp32 buffer that gets silently downcast, causing precision loss in routing decisions.
invariant: expert_bias.dtype must be torch.float32 during routing. bf16/fp16 = bug.
fixed_behavior: _maintain_float32_expert_bias() restores fp32 at each forward pass
notes: Supports --mock-data. Same detection paradigm as M-024 (dtype check).

expected_output.buggy: BUG DETECTED: expert_bias has wrong dtype
